patch_description: Adds a swap-based local search phase after the move-based phase. Moves alone can stall when no destination GPU has memory headroom; swapping a model from the worst-KVPR GPU with a smaller model on another GPU preserves total memory usage per GPU within feasibility and can escape local optima. Uses the same strict-improvement threshold (1e-12) and bounded restart pattern (max 300 iterations), trying moves and swaps alternately until no operator improves the global max KVPR.
